name: backup_list_restore_points
description: Lists restore points for the current site, newest first, with their capture trigger and cost class.

name: backup_get_capabilities
description: Reports this site's restore-point cost class and mechanism kind. For repository backups, call repo_capabilities then repo_backup_push. Rendered static output commits are a separate publishing workflow.

name: backup_plan_restore
description: Previews what restoring to a given restore point would change, including the discarded-write-window disclosure.

restorePointId.description: A restore point id, as returned by records_read.restore_point.

name: backup_execute_restore
description: Replaces this site's current data with a restore point. Shows the user a confirm dialog first and only runs if they confirm. No restore point is taken first, so it can't be undone. Call backup_plan_restore first to see what would be lost.

restorePointId.description: A restore point id, as returned by records_read.restore_point.

name: backup_create_restore_point
description: Mints a new restore point independent of any migration, subject to the site's cost-acknowledgment rule.

name: recovery_get_status
description: Reports this site's current restore-point cost class plus the single highest-precedence degraded-state banner (migration interrupted, pending migration, an operation already in flight, cost class unavailable, or watermark baseline unavailable), if any.

name: recovery_resolve_deep_link
description: Re-resolves a Database-Timeline deep-link envelope server-side (SPEC-123): looks up the envelope's restorePointId against the current restore-points list rather than trusting the envelope's own carried value. A stale or forged id resolves to found:false.

correlationId.description: The incident/correlation id minted when this deep-link's chain began.

siteId.description: The site/workspace id the envelope was minted for. Re-verified server-side, never trusted as-is.

ledgerEventId.description: The database ledger row id this envelope points at, or null.

restorePointId.description: The restore point id this envelope points at, or null. Re-looked-up server-side; a stale or forged id resolves to found:false rather than being trusted.

drift.description: The drift status carried for display continuity only; never trusted as authoritative.

intent.description: The carried intent (e.g. 'view'), for display continuity only.

issuedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the envelope was minted at.
